answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the ripple is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The dawn holds work receipts rather than names, so the trellis of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
